auto-approve.name: Full access
auto-approve.description: Vibe tools run without Vibe's approval card, including outside the folder. Vibe Work's protected actions still need your permission.

smart-approve.name: Smart approve
smart-approve.description: A model checks each tool call. Safe ones run, risky ones ask.

accept-edits.name: Accept edits
accept-edits.description: File edits run. Commands and anything outside the folder ask.

plan.name: Plan first
plan.description: Vibe plans before it changes files. Not read-only: shell commands can still change files.

vw-plan.name: Plan on a page
vw-plan.description: Plans first and writes the plan as a page in the project's handbook (docs/handbook/plans/). Other file writes are refused; shell commands still run.
vw-plan.tooltip: Use Plan on a page access mode

explore.name: Explore
explore.description: Explore the project with Vibe's configured profile.

off.name: off
off.description: Turn off the model's optional thinking.

max.name: max
max.description: Use the model's largest offered thinking budget.

vibeWork.name: Vibe Work vault
vibeWork.description: Private to this app, in its own folder, with your own password.
vibeWork.tooltip: Create a new Vibe Work vault

shellx.name: ShellX Vault
shellx.description: Open the vault you already use in ShellX.

desktop.name: Vault app
desktop.description: Open the vault you already use in the Vault app.

askEachTime.name: Ask each time
askEachTime.description: Ask before agent use; commands and sites you already granted remain allowed.
askEachTime.tooltip: Ask before agent use; commands and sites you already granted remain allowed.

allowed.name: Allowed
allowed.description: Standing permission during delegated tasks. Local sign-ins still ask each time; MCP forwarding also needs its server grant.
allowed.tooltip: Standing permission during delegated tasks. Local sign-ins still ask each time; MCP forwarding also needs its server grant.

never.name: Never
never.tooltip: Refuse agent use. MCP forwarding is blocked while this entry's default or any project refuses.

closeUserTabs.name: Close tabs you opened
closeUserTabs.description: Choose whether the agent asks before closing a tab you opened or took over.
closeUserTabs.tooltip: Ask me requests Close or Keep for each tab you opened or took over. Allow skips that question. The App preview cannot be closed.

closeAsk.name: Ask me (default)
closeAsk.description: Ask before the agent closes a tab you opened or took over.
closeAsk.tooltip: Ask you to Close or Keep each tab you opened or took over.

closeAllow.name: Allow
closeAllow.description: Let the agent close tabs you opened or took over during your task.
closeAllow.tooltip: The agent may close tabs you opened or took over during your task without asking again.

agentPause.name: Pause agent access to secrets
agentPause.description: Agent access to secrets is paused. Sessions keep working.
agentPause.tooltip: Pause the agent's access to secrets. Sessions keep working.

agentResume.name: Resume agent access to secrets
agentResume.description: Agent access to secrets is available. Sessions keep working.
agentResume.tooltip: Resume the agent's access to secrets. Sessions keep working.

vaultLock.name: Lock vault
vaultLock.description: The vault is locked. Sessions stop until you unlock.
vaultLock.tooltip: Lock the vault. Sessions stop until you unlock.

vaultUnlock.name: Unlock vault
vaultUnlock.description: The vault is unlocked. Sessions can work again.
vaultUnlock.tooltip: Unlock the vault. Sessions can work again.

texts.accessDefaultDescription: The mode new sessions start in. Full access asks you to confirm first.
texts.customAccessDescription: A profile from your Vibe configuration.
texts.defaultModelDescription: The model new sessions start with.
texts.modelDescription: A model from your Vibe configuration.
texts.defaultThinkingDescription: New chats start with this level. You can change it in each chat.
texts.modelDefaultThinkingDescription: Follow the selected model's own thinking default.
texts.customThinkingDescription: A thinking level reported by your model.
texts.thinkingUnavailable: Saved thinking level “{level}” is not offered by {model}; using the model's own default.
texts.vaultChoiceEmpty: No existing vault was found on this computer. Create a Vibe Work vault to continue.
texts.agentPausedNotice: Agent access to secrets is paused. Sessions keep working.
texts.agentPausedRefusal: Not run: agent access to secrets is paused. There is no access to secrets until the user resumes it.
texts.vaultLockedNotice: The vault is locked. Sessions stop until you unlock.
texts.permissionNeedsProject: Choose a project to change permissions.
texts.browserDelegationHint: Tab closing permissions apply only while the agent does a task you gave it. Ask me asks before closing one of your tabs.
texts.secretPermissionsSummary: Choose each Vault entry's permission in Vault. Browser delegation does not change secret access.
